objective: Fast-end low-cost compression improvements aiming for stable first place by current competition-pool share.
scope: Research implementation, experiment-branch commits and pushes, manual public GitHub runner experiments, full public gates and independent confirmation. No formal competition upload, registration, wallet signing or spending.
running_job_policy: Already started jobs finish naturally or at their declared timeout. No new research after the fixed deadline.
worktree_policy: One existing checkout; agents have nonoverlapping file ownership.
completion_scope: Research window completion is separate from achieving stable first place or a formal payable result.
